raw_ocr_text:
BEGINNING at a point in the Westerly line of Birchall Drive distant 486.81 feet Northwardly from the Northerly end of the curve connecting the Westerly line of Birchall Drive with the Northerly line of Kings Highway, said connecting curve having a radius of 75.00 feet; thence

(1) Northwardly along the Westerly line of Birchall Drive 90.00 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 6 and 7; thence

(2) Westwardly along said division line at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.74 feet to a point in the Westerly boundary line of said plan; thence

(3) Southwardly along said boundary line forming an interior angle 89 degrees 52 minutes with the last course the distance of 90.00 feet to a point; thence

(4) Eastwardly forming an interior angle of 90 degrees 08 minutes with the last course at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.53 feet to the place of BEGINNING.

BEING part of Lot 6, on Plan of Country Club Estates, made by Walter H. Macnamara, C.E., dated December 1956, revised January 14, 1957 and duly filed in the Camden County Register of Deeds Office on July 15, 1958 as File 121 Map 10.

BEING commonly known as 32 Birchall Drive.

Being known as Block 91.11, Lot 32 as shown on the Official Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

expected_closure.closure_notes: Cannot compute closure — all 4 calls have cardinal-only bearings. Interior angles (89°52' and 90°08') suggest near-rectangular parcel ~90 × 112.64 ft ≈ 10,137 sq ft.

all_cardinal_only.description: All 4 calls use cardinal-only directions (Northwardly, Westwardly, Southwardly, Eastwardly) with no numeric bearings

no_fabricated_bearings.description: bearing_quadrant and bearing_azimuth_deg_from_north MUST be null for all calls — never invent bearings from cardinal directions

closure_not_computed.description: Closure calculation cannot proceed without numeric bearings — closure_passed MUST be false

common_failure_modes.symptom: Fabricated numeric bearings (e.g., N 0° E for 'Northwardly')
common_failure_modes.cause: Parser converting cardinal directions to assumed bearings instead of leaving null
common_failure_modes.fix: Cardinal-only directions must result in null bearing_quadrant and null bearing_azimuth_deg_from_north with notes='incomplete bearing - cardinal only'

common_failure_modes.symptom: Interior angle text merged into 'along' field for calls 3 and 4
common_failure_modes.cause: Parser not separating interior angle clauses from along/to field extraction
common_failure_modes.fix: Interior angle text ('forming an interior angle...') should be parsed separately, not included in along or to fields

common_failure_modes.symptom: Closure reported as passed with fabricated azimuths
common_failure_modes.cause: System assumed N/S/E/W map to 0/180/90/270 and computed closure
common_failure_modes.fix: Without explicit degree-minute-second bearings, closure computation must be skipped
Call extractor must handle both '1.' and '(1)' numbering formats
